notes.title: Font bug fix
notes.content: Fix the bug of missing fonts when switching between Simplified and Traditional Chinese

notes.title: 8.24 Updates and Optimizations
notes.content: [p]Added a direct cable car from Permafrost Mountain to the farm in the late game.[/p][p]Fixed misaligned UI issues in some store interfaces.[/p][p]Added an additional commemorative item after achieving all endings.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the frame rate could exceed the limit under certain circumstances.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where characters would get stuck after power depletion in new save files.[/p][p]Adjusted the rollback mechanism after achieving any ending—now the game will auto-save upon ending completion (does not affect the achievement of multiple endings in a single save file).[/p][p]Fixed a bug that occurred when fishing after equipping the Constructor Chip.[/p]

notes.title: 8.18 Fix
notes.content:
For backpack items, synthesis machines, crop upgrading machines, and composting machines, adding the option to click on item equipment/use/put in now eliminates the need to drag and drop them one by one.
By modifying the water output efficiency of the hand pressure water pump, water will definitely be obtained within two to three times, and relying on the water pump to obtain water in the early stage will be more stable.
Optimize the large capacity water tank and now have the capability of efficient water tanks.
Adjusted the issue of excessive noise in the synthesis machine.
Fixed the issue where items in the radiation zone may get stuck outside the map and cannot be picked up.
Fixed the issue of sound when adjusting the volume to 0.

notes.title: 8.16 Fix
notes.content:
Optimize the speed of long press fishing mode. Long press fishing mode will become easier, and players who find it difficult to fish can turn it on in the menu settings.
Fix some text and texture errors.
